run_training: run detectron2 model training from a LazyConfig Python config file with multi-GPU DDP support
run_evaluation: run evaluation only on a detectron2 model using a LazyConfig file and a saved checkpoint
review_do_train: review the do_train function that instantiates models, optimizers, dataloaders, and registers training hooks
review_do_test: review the do_test function that runs inference_on_dataset and prints results in CSV format
review_main: review the main function that loads LazyConfig, applies overrides, and branches to eval or training
